summary: Iteration 10 testing of the News & Märkte extension (sections 16-21). Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_news_markte_sections.py — 16/16 pass (anlagetrends=9 items, investment-radar=6, market-voices=6, feed for all 9 categories + alle, markets, editorial; no _id leakage). Frontend /news: all 5 new sections render with correct counts on desktop (fonds-etf-card=3, radar-row=6 + radar-table, anlagetrend-card=9, voice-card=6, unsere-einordnung populated, 9 watch links) and on mobile 390px (radar-card-mobile=6, table hidden, no horizontal overflow). All 7 existing filter tabs switch the ticker correctly (maerkte 2, aktien 1, wirtschaft 2, unternehmen 2, zinsen 3, international 2, alle 12). Existing sections (Hero, Markt-Insights, News im Überblick, Weitere Beiträge, Anleger, Unsere Einschätzung, PhilosophieCTA) all still render. CRITICAL DEFECT: every /news/{category} detail route is dead — the 9 static routes render NewsCategoryDetail without a :category param so the component immediately Navigate-redirects to /news. Detail pages only work under /news/kategorie/{slug}, which nothing in the UI links to.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: /news/aktien, /news/fonds-etfs, /news/rohstoffe, /news/seltene-erden, /news/anleihen, /news/zinsen, /news/waehrungen, /news/investmenttrends, /news/unternehmen ALL redirect back to /news. Root cause: these are declared as static paths (<Route path="/news/aktien" element={<NewsCategoryDetail/>} />) so useParams() returns {} -> category === undefined -> CATEGORY_META[undefined] undefined -> <Navigate to="/news" replace/>. Verified: /news/kategorie/rohstoffe|fonds-etfs|aktien render perfectly (h1 'Rohstoffe', filtered tile XAU/USD; 'Fonds & ETFs' with DAX/SPX/NDX/SX5E; 'Aktien' with DAX/DJI/SPX/NDX/SX5E; back-to-news present), so only the route wiring is wrong.

Consequence of the above: all 9 watch-link-* hrefs, fonds-etf-all-link (/news/fonds-etfs) and the 8 'Weitere Themen' links on the detail page point at the broken /news/{slug} paths. Clicking watch-link-rohstoffe leaves the user on /news with no feedback.

'Meldung' links are hardcoded to the external absolute domain https://kapital-direkt24.de/news/{related_slug} instead of an internal route — leaves the app and is not env-driven. Also the mobile radar cards drop the Meldung link entirely (feature parity gap).

integration_issues.issue: Full flow /news -> click category -> detail page is non-functional in the shipped route configuration (see CRITICAL above). Data layer is fine: /api/news-markte/feed?category={slug} returns correct filtered items for all 9 slugs.

issues: Kennzeichnung badges wrap onto two lines ('LANGFRISTIGER TREND', 'ERHÖHTE MARKTAKTIVITÄT') and have inconsistent widths, making the column look ragged — consider whitespace-nowrap or a wider column
Last row has only one filled cell (09 Unternehmen) and it still renders a right border, leaving a dangling 1px divider next to empty space

Seed images are semantically irrelevant: 'Kupferpreis zieht an' shows a misty castle gate (photo-1518709268805) and 'Silber profitiert von industriellem Bedarf' shows a fashion portrait (photo-1621786030484)

action_items: FIX ROUTING (blocker): replace the 9 static /news/{slug} routes with a param route, e.g. keep a single <Route path="/news/kategorie/:category" .../> plus <Route path="/news/:category" element={<NewsCategoryDetail/>} /> ordered before /news/:slug, OR pass the slug explicitly as a prop (element={<NewsCategoryDetail category="aktien"/>}) and read it as `const { category: p } = useParams(); const category = props.category ?? p;`. Beware the existing catch-all /news/:slug (PublicNewsDetailPage) which currently swallows unknown slugs.

After the routing fix, re-verify all 9 detail pages render news-category-{slug} and that /news/unknown-slug still resolves sensibly (currently it falls through to PublicNewsDetailPage, not a redirect to /news).
Make InvestmentRadar 'Meldung' links internal (or env-driven) and expose them on the mobile card layout too.
Fix ragged Kennzeichnung badge column and the dangling border on the last Beobachtungslisten cell.
Replace the irrelevant Unsplash seed images for the Kupfer and Silber rohstoffe articles.
critical_code_review_comments: NewsCategoryDetail depends on a route param that 9 of its 10 registered routes never supply — a param/props contract mismatch that silently degrades to a redirect with no console error, making it easy to miss.
Hardcoded external domain kapital-direkt24.de in InvestmentRadar.jsx violates the no-hardcoded-URL rule; should derive from env or use an internal route.

StimmenZumMarkt splits the editorial body on /\n{2,}/ while seeded bodies use single newlines (carried over from iteration_9) — the 'Unsere Einordnung' excerpt therefore renders only the first physical line.
test_credentials: Not required — /news and /news/{category} are public. Visitor gate bypassed via add_init_script setting kapitalmitte_visitor_profile + kapitalmitte_cookie_consent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite for this area: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_news_markte_sections.py (16 cases, all pass). Note the markets endpoint is /api/news-markte/markets (NOT /market-insights). Frontend testing requires context.add_init_script presetting localStorage kapitalmitte_visitor_profile + kapitalmitte_cookie_consent before goto, else VisitorWelcomeGate blocks. Verified working testids on /news: hero-top-news, markt-insights, news-ueberblick (filters use data-testid news-filter-{alle|maerkte|aktien|wirtschaft|unternehmen|zinsen|international}, NOT news-tab-*), fonds-etf-top-news/fonds-etf-card(3)/fonds-etf-all-link, investment-radar/radar-table/radar-row(6)/radar-card-mobile(6, md:hidden), anlagetrends/anlagetrend-card(9), stimmen-zum-markt/voice-card(6)/unsere-einordnung, beobachtungslisten/watch-link-{9 slugs}, cta-contact. Detail pages currently ONLY reachable at /news/kategorie/{slug}. No console errors, no horizontal overflow at 1920 or 390px, no broken images on /news. Admin editorial UI remains out of scope/blocked (iteration_9).
rca_of_the_issue: App.js registers NewsCategoryDetail on nine literal paths (/news/aktien … /news/unternehmen). react-router only populates useParams() from dynamic segments, so on those paths `const { category } = useParams()` is undefined; CATEGORY_META[undefined] is undefined and the component's guard `if (!meta) return <Navigate to="/news" replace/>` fires on every one of them. Reproduction: goto https://finance-platform-v2.preview.emergentagent.com/news/rohstoffe -> URL becomes /news and [data-testid='news-category-rohstoffe'] count is 0, while /news/kategorie/rohstoffe renders correctly (h1 'Rohstoffe', market-tile-XAU/USD, back-to-news). Mitigation: use a dynamic segment (/news/:category) placed before the /news/:slug catch-all, or pass the slug as a prop with a props-over-params fallback.
